constraints.action: receive at least 5 cmH2O of positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) at time of diagnosis
consider patients not receiving positive pressure as suffering from ARDS
use low tidal volume ventilation strategies (i.e., 4–8 ml/kg PBW)
measure and adjust Vt using PBW
use prolonged high-pressure recruitment maneuvers (defined as airway pressure maintained ≥ 35 cmH2O for at least one minute)
abort the maneuver immediately if cardiovascular instability ensues during brief high-pressure RMs

start prone position in patients with ARDS receiving invasive mechanical ventilation early after intubation, after a period of stabilization during which low tidal volume is applied and PEEP adjusted and at the end of which the PaO2/FiO2 remains < 150 mmHg
apply prone position for prolonged sessions
routine use of continuous infusions of NMBA to reduce mortality in patients with moderate-to-severe ARDS not due to COVID-19

treat patients with severe ARDS not due to COVID-19 as defined by the EOLIA trial eligibility criteria with ECMO in an ECMO center which meets defined organizational standards, adhering to a management strategy similar to that used in the EOLIA trial
have an ECMO team with capacity to transfer patients on ECMO (mobile ECMO) with centralization of patients from non-ECMO centers
use ECCO2R for the treatment of ARDS not due to COVID-19 to prevent mortality outside of randomized controlled trials
